biotools.summary: paramix is an R package that simplifies the transformations between high and low resolution data in infectious disease compartmental models, particularly for calculating age-sensitive measures like years of life lost. It facilitates aggregation and disaggregation of epidemic parameters and outcomes for modeling and simulation.
